scope: Storybook desktop catalog and verified capture identity
limitations: Headless WebKit renders the production document with isolated native observations inside Storybook. This review verifies captions, composition, readable detail, focus visibility and relationships. Native OS input, Rust command integration and assistive technology were not exercised.
